# Florence 1490 – Economy & finance

<!-- generated by scripts/build_techtree.py from eras/europe-1490-florence.yaml — do not edit -->

K = knowledge level · use = none/wrong/partial/correct · make = producibility with local means · accept = acceptance.

- **Coinage (stamped metal money)** [`coinage`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/coinage.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. The gold florin (since 1252) is Europe's standard coin, hammer-struck. Wages are paid in debased silver and copper, big trade in gold: a standing grievance. Local: Zecca (mint) beside the Palazzo della Signoria.
- **Double-entry bookkeeping** [`double_entry`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/double_entry.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Florentine merchant houses and some public offices keep double-entry books. Practice varies among small shops. Pacioli's printed exposition appears in Venice in 1494. Local: Medici bank; Florentine merchant ledgers.
- **Interest-bearing loans, pledges and limits on debt bondage** [`interest_loans_collateral`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/interest_loans_collateral.md) — K4, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Open interest is the sin of usury, so bankers hide it in exchange rates and 'gifts' on deposits. Licensed Jewish pawnbrokers serve the poor at high rates. Local: Jewish loan banks (licensed since 1437); Arte del Cambio.
- **Deposit banking and bills of exchange** [`banking_credit`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/banking_credit.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Florentine firms use deposits, book transfers and bills of exchange. The Medici bank has lost its northern branches. Other merchant houses still offer international credit. Local: Medici bank; Strozzi, Gondi and Capponi houses; Mercato Nuovo (bankers' tables).
- **Paper money** [`paper_money`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/paper_money.md) — K1, use none, make medium, accept low. Read of in Marco Polo as a marvel of the Khan. Florentines trust gold and book credit with known names; a note from the commune would be distrusted. Elsewhere: China (Ming notes by now nearly worthless).
- **Money supply, debasement and inflation** [`quantity_theory_inflation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/quantity_theory_inflation.md) — K1, use none, make easy, accept medium. Oresme's tract on debasement is known; the mint knows bad coin drives out good. That more money raises all prices is not a stated idea.
- **Risk-sharing partnership (commenda, mudaraba)** [`partnership_commenda`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/partnership_commenda.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Trading companies are partnerships renewed every few years; limited partnership (accomandita) has been legal in Florence since 1408.
- **Joint-stock company and limited liability** [`joint_stock_company`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/joint_stock_company.md) — K2, use none, make medium, accept medium. Florentine trading partnerships are often renewed for fixed terms. Limited partners already exist. Transferable Monte credits and Genoa's San Giorgio offer comparisons for pooled capital. Elsewhere: Genoa: Casa di San Giorgio, maone.
- **Insurance (marine, fire, life)** [`insurance`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/insurance.md) — K4, use partial, make easy, accept high. Brokers circulate marine policies among underwriters. Route, wartime danger and reported piracy affect premiums. A Florentine broker can compare prices for similar voyages. Local: insurance brokers at the Mercato Nuovo. Elsewhere: Genoa, Barcelona: insurance ordinances.
- **Life tables and the pricing of annuities** [`life_tables_annuities`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/life_tables_annuities.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept medium. The Monte delle Doti prices marriage payments contingent on survival. Its ledgers and the death registers provide evidence for constructing a local survival table. Local: Monte delle Doti ledgers; Baptistery registers; Libri dei morti.
- **Public debt and government bonds** [`public_debt_bonds`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/public_debt_bonds.md) — K4, use partial, make easy, accept medium. The Monte Comune (1340s) consolidates forced loans into transferable interest-bearing credits. Interest is often cut or delayed, so credits trade far below face value. Local: Monte Comune; Ufficiali del Monte. Elsewhere: Venice: Monte Vecchio and Nuovo; Genoa: San Giorgio.
- **Stock exchange (securities market)** [`stock_exchange`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/stock_exchange.md) — K2, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Brokers trade Monte credits, exchange and insurance at the Mercato Nuovo, without fixed rules or published prices. Local: Mercato Nuovo. Elsewhere: Bruges, merchants' bourse; Antwerp, commercial fairs; Lyon, exchange fairs.
- **Central bank and lender of last resort** [`central_bank`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/central_bank.md) — K1, use none, make hard, accept low. No standing lender of last resort exists. Emergency support depends on patrons and public funds. The Monte manages public debt. Elsewhere: Barcelona: Taula de Canvi (public deposit bank, 1401); Genoa: Casa di San Giorgio.
- **Division of labour and specialisation** [`division_of_labour`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/division_of_labour.md) — K4, use correct, make easy, accept high. Wool cloth passes through some two dozen specialised trades under a merchant's direction (putting-out). Practised, never theorised, and not centralised under one roof. Local: Arte della Lana; Arte della Seta. Elsewhere: Venice Arsenal: galleys fitted out in sequence.
- **Comparative advantage and free trade** [`comparative_advantage_free_trade`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/comparative_advantage_free_trade.md) — K1, use none, make easy, accept low. Policy is protection: foreign cloth is banned, subject towns may not compete with Florentine guilds, raw wool and alum routes are fought over.
- **Prices, supply and demand** [`price_mechanism_supply_demand`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/price_mechanism_supply_demand.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Merchants and moral theologians (Antoninus) know prices follow scarcity. In dearth the city fixes bread prices and hunts hoarders. Local: Grascia and Abbondanza (provisions offices).
- **Public granaries and price stabilisation (ever-normal granary)** [`ever_normal_granary`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/ever_normal_granary.md) — K3, use partial, make medium, accept high. The Abbondanza purchases grain and sells it in times of dearth. Financing and maintaining a regular reserve would build on familiar civic provisioning. Local: Ufficiali dell'Abbondanza; Orsanmichele (former grain hall). Elsewhere: Venice: public grain stores; China: ever-normal granaries.
- **Income tax and progressive rates** [`progressive_income_tax`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/progressive_income_tax.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept low. Florence's catasto assesses household wealth. A graduated scale adopted in 1480 applies in the 1481 assessment. This differs from a tax on annual earnings. Local: Catasto officials; Monte.
- **Savings banks, credit and consumer cooperatives** [`cooperatives_savings_banks`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/cooperatives_savings_banks.md) — K2, use none, make easy, accept medium. Franciscans found cheap public pawn banks (Monte di Pietà) across Italy; Florence has refused one so far (it comes in 1495–96). Elsewhere: Perugia, Siena and Bologna, charitable pawn banks.
- **Wealth as productivity; sustained economic growth** [`economic_growth_productivity`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/economic_growth_productivity.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Wealth means treasure, land and the city's share of a fixed trade. That output per head could keep rising is unimagined.
- **National income accounts (GDP)** [`national_accounts_gdp`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/national_accounts_gdp.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Raw material exists: tax declarations, customs (gabelle) books, chroniclers' counts of shops and looms. Households fear any count as a new tax. Local: Catasto records; gabelle offices; Benedetto Dei's lists of Florentine firms.
- **Fighting slumps by sustaining demand (Keynesian policy)** [`aggregate_demand_countercyclical_policy`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/aggregate_demand_countercyclical_policy.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Money is coin and the commune is always in debt. Building work to employ the poor is understood as charity.
